shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- project files ---\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/i18n && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | head -60 && printf '\\n--- uikit lang docs ---\\n' && rg -n -i \"configure\\(|lang|i18n|Provider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "cat src/main.tsx src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- i18n exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"export\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- i18n readme ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 \"I18n|createLang|registerKeysets|configure|useTranslation|i18n\\(\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -160; printf '\\n--- uikit readme ---\\n'; sed -n '40,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"SegmentedControl\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; rg -n -C 5 \"interface SegmentedControlProps|type SegmentedControl\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; printf '\\n--- i18n d.ts ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/I18N.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -iname '*SegmentedControl*' | head -30; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' | head -120 && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src refs ---\\n' && rg -n \"ReactDOM|createRoot|import .*@gravity-ui|<div|title|lang\" src --ignore-case | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -type f -iname '*Segmented*' -print | head -20; rg -n \"configure\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20; rg -n -C 8 \"export declare const SegmentedControl|SegmentedControlProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; printf '\\n--- i18n source keys ---\\n'; rg -n \"function i18n|function setLang|registerKeyset\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/I18N.js | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; printf '\\n--- project ---\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | sort; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- src ---\\n'; find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo --- "'$1; sed -n "1,220p" "$1"'"' _ {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- uikit docs/README setup ---\\n'; sed -n '75,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '\\n--- uikit typecheck/exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"export declare const (Select|RadioGroup)|interface SelectProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc 'which apply_patch || ls /usr/bin/apply_patch /bin/apply_patch 2>/dev/null || true; cat src/i18n.tsx 2>/dev/null; cat src/LanguageSwitcher.tsx 2>/dev/null; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; nl -ba src/i18n.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba src/LanguageSwitcher.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'; nl -ba src/main.tsx | sed -n '10,40p'"
